title: Naruto: The Broken Bond (Naruto: The Broken Bond Android Port)
description: Unofficial native Android port of Naruto: The Broken Bond (Xbox 360), statically recompiled with the ReXGlue SDK and drawn with Vulkan. Fights at 60 FPS, story mode at the game's own 30 FPS (60 with frame interpolation on newer Snapdragons). For Snapdragon/Adreno devices. Developed by 1nsec.
